description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns validation + record-coverage only - whether the SDK name + version are well-formed and the coverage statement (the pinned record establishes no SDK identifier and no fixed version for any flaw, so a paid check of any well-formed pair grades NOT-IN-RECORD in v1). No per-flaw grading is performed and no verdict is returned. The full signed report is the paid sdk_safety_check call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

sdk.description: The x402 SDK name to check against the pinned flaw snapshot.

version.description: The SDK version to check (semver: optional leading v, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optional -prerelease / +build).

name: sdk_safety_precheck
